WITH event_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(corpeventprx, 'No Event') AS event_type,
    AVG(anlycount) AS avg_analyst_coverage,
    AVG(inholdpct - instownpct) AS avg_insider_minus_inst
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  GROUP BY corpeventprx
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_insider_minus_inst) AS overall_avg_diff
  FROM event_stats
)
SELECT 
  es.event_type,
  es.avg_analyst_coverage,
  es.avg_insider_minus_inst,
  es.avg_insider_minus_inst - oa.overall_avg_diff AS difference_from_overall_average
FROM event_stats es
CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
WHERE oa.overall_avg_diff IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY es.event_type
